metadata.title: SSPP – DNS Secure Dynamic Update
metadata.remarks: System Security & Privacy Plan template defining institutional requirements for secure DNS dynamic update operations (RFC 2136 and equivalents).

import-profile.remarks: Imports institutional baseline security, governance, and audit requirements applicable to privileged infrastructure services.

system-characteristics.system-description: Privileged DNS service enabling controlled and auditable modification of DNS records by authorized clients through dynamic update mechanisms.

props.name: platform-capability
props.remarks: This SSPP governs DNS dynamic update operations that modify authoritative DNS state.

props.name: usage-constraint
props.remarks: Dynamic updates are control-plane operations and MUST NOT be exposed as general DNS resolution capabilities.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: Authorization to modify DNS records does not imply authority to resolve, transfer, or delegate DNS zones.

system-implementation.remarks: This SSPP defines governance, authentication, authorization, integrity, and audit expectations for DNS dynamic updates. It does not redefine DNS resolution, caching, or availability behaviors.

components.title: DNS Dynamic Update Governance
components.description: Defines policy, approval, and scope constraints for dynamic DNS writers.

links.text: Relies on Secure-DNS for authoritative DNS behavior, zoning boundaries, and trust assertions.
Relies on Secure-Networking for protected transport paths between DNS writers and authoritative servers.
Relies on Secure-Time for TTL calculation, change ordering, and audit correctness.

components.title: Dynamic Update Authentication and Authorization
components.description: Defines how DNS writers authenticate and what record scopes they are authorized to modify.

components.title: Dynamic Update Integrity and Validation
components.description: Ensures updates are validated, constrained, and cannot corrupt authoritative DNS state.

components.title: Dynamic Update Observability and Audit
components.description: Defines logging, monitoring, and rollback support for DNS dynamic update activity.

roles.title: DNS Dynamic Update Policy Authority
roles.remarks: Defines institutional policy, approval criteria, and risk tolerance for DNS write access via dynamic update.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Executive Cyber Leadership per NIST NICE Framework (SP 800-181).

roles.title: DNS Dynamic Update Architect
roles.remarks: Designs dynamic update models, authorization scopes, identity bindings, and containment strategies.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Security Architect per NIST NICE Framework.

roles.title: DNS Dynamic Update Operations
roles.remarks: Implements and operates approved dynamic update mechanisms, credentials, and lifecycle controls.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Systems Administrator per NIST NICE Framework.

roles.title: DNS Dynamic Update Monitoring and Assurance
roles.remarks: Monitors DNS write activity, detects misuse or drift, and supports investigation and rollback.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Security Operations Analyst per NIST NICE Framework.

control-implementation.remarks: Control satisfaction is achieved through strict authentication and authorization of DNS writers, validation of updates, bounded scope, and auditability. This SSPP introduces no compensating controls.
